content: ⌊ DRAFT g In case a Diagnostic Event configured in the Dem High Proxy is not connected to any Dem Low Proxy , the Dem High Proxy shall return E_NOT_OK and the value 0 for the Bufsize argument, when Dem_- GetEventFreezeFrameDataEx / GetEventFreezeFrameDataEx is called. The Bufsize argument stays unmodified.
